title: Unconditional Bounds for Two, Three and Four Consecutive Moderate Gaps between Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
summary: We prove unconditional positive-proportion results for consecutive moderate gaps between zeros of the Riemann zeta function. More precisely, for every fixed \(0<c\leq 1/4\), the lower asymptotic densities, normalized by \(N(T)\), of the occurrences of two, three, and four consecutive gaps, each of length at least \(2πc/\log T\), are at least \(0.3450014\ldots\), \(0.1812517\ldots\), and \(0.0175021\ldots\), respectively.
